note: All three postings in files/ are fictional, written to exercise one decision path each. Re-run after any change to SKILL.md or the references; the expected decisions below follow from the current evidence and should only change when the evidence does.

evals.name: analytics-engineer-depth-and-adjacent-gaps
evals.prompt: found this analytics engineer role at northwind grocers, toronto hybrid. should i apply? what would you change on my resume? posting is in evals/files/analytics-engineer-northwind.txt
evals.expected_output: Apply now (competitive). Production dbt flagged as a depth gap and the screen risk, Snowflake and Looker as adjacent-tool gaps, code review as unknown. At most three edits, led by surfacing the dbt project. Matches references/example-report.md in substance.

assertions.text: Decision is 'Apply now' (competitive), not Skip or Stretch
Production dbt (2+ years) is classified as a depth gap, not a match and not a hard gate
Snowflake is not claimed as used; it is described as never run / profile only
Looker is treated as an adjacent-tool gap and is not added to the résumé
Toronto location is 'met' via stated relocation across Canada, not assumed from elsewhere
No more than three résumé edits are proposed, each citing existing evidence
No résumé edit adds a tool from inventory §5 or drops a qualifier such as 'not production' or 'internal estimate'
Evidence fit and visible fit are both reported with their totals

evals.name: data-analyst-strong-match-wording-only
evals.prompt: Can you run a role fit on this one before I apply today? evals/files/data-analyst-coastal.txt
evals.expected_output: Apply now (strong): every Must row is PAID. Only optional wording edits, e.g. 'ETL' alongside 'ELT' and surfacing fill rate from the vendor scorecards, with no invented KPIs.

assertions.text: All hard gates are met: Vancouver hybrid, Canada eligibility, 2+ years (4 yrs 3 mos), quantitative bachelor's
'ETL tools' is identified as a wording gap mapped to Azure Data Factory / Fabric pipelines / SSIS
Edits are presented as optional quick wins, not as a precondition to applying
Fill rate is sourced to Two Rivers vendor scorecards and is not added to the governed-KPI list as if it had been one
Logistics industry experience is not overstated: Two Rivers is a distributor with logistics analytics, not a freight carrier

evals.name: senior-bsa-hard-gates-skip
evals.prompt: recruiter sent me this senior business systems analyst role in seattle, thoughts? evals/files/senior-bsa-meridian.txt
evals.expected_output: Skip on unmet hard gates (7+ years vs 4 yrs 3 mos, CBAP required, people management), with US work authorization and on-site Seattle as unknowns, not assumed. Short report: gates table plus where to aim instead. No résumé edits.

assertions.text: Decision is Skip, naming the unmet gates: 7+ years, CBAP, managing analysts
US work authorization is marked unknown (not met, not unmet-by-assumption) and raised as a question
No requirement table or résumé edits follow the Skip
Salesforce, Jira and HIPAA are not claimed anywhere
Suggests where to aim instead (e.g. intermediate BA / data-focused BA roles in Canada)
